question: What out-of-plane compressive strain was imposed on the V2O5, what in-plane tensile strain does the Poisson estimate give for it and with what coefficient, and what is the ratio of the two?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%poisson%' OR text ILIKE '%compressive%' OR text ILIKE '%out-of-plane%' OR text ILIKE '%in-plane%' OR text ILIKE '%ratio%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=3 AND line_no BETWEEN 8 AND 30 OR (page=3 AND id IN ('p3.L54','p3.L64')) ORDER BY page, line_no
